label: directed communication to
definition: X directs information, speech, a request, warning or advice to addressee Y.
scope_notes: Ask, urge, tell, notify, address and message-to qualify. Replacing/firing a predecessor, taking office, athletic defeat, support and physical transfers alone do not. Send with no object is ambiguous unless another case-local row supplies clear communication.

facts.reason: Charles Brecher is director or research director of Citizens Budget Commission; no outgoing communication to the commission is expressed.
Joe Morgan replaces or succeeds John McNamara as manager. Succession is not communication to the predecessor.
Danny Meyer owns or is a partner in Union Square Cafe and comments on its selection. Commenting about the cafe does not address communication to it.
Bush Administration directly urges and asks Congress, with its officials telling congressional negotiators. This supports institutional communication through representatives.
Reagan asks, urges and tells Congress and sends it a message; blame rows add a distinct meaning.
